fields.name: OldSwarmGroup
fields.evidence: esv::ai::swarm::MemberSystem::UpdateMembers (EoCServer.dll+0x16A3080): for each entity of the request map it reads the current group FixedString from the entity's eoc::ai::swarm::MemberComponent (FUN_180bbf0c0, Empty when absent) and, when it differs from the requested one, writes it to value +0.

fields.name: NewSwarmGroup
fields.evidence: Same function writes the requested group (value of the HashMap<EntityHandle, FixedString> argument) to value +4; the pair is then copied into the singleton and into the entity's MemberChangedEvent.

fields.name: Changes
fields.evidence: UpdateMembers gets this singleton (FUN_1816a1ce0), clears it (FUN_18169ab10 / FUN_180226330) and for every alive entity inserts the entity as key (FUN_1816a1770(singleton, entity)) and assigns two FixedStrings to the returned 8-byte value. Adder bg3.exe+0x3258980 allocates 0x40 bytes and zeroes them. Live: 4 instances of cleared maps (bucket count 29/43, key/value capacity 32, size 0).
